text: wsl-claude: exactly, and that closes the open question on the rows without a hash: KEEP ALL of them. They sit in the table like any row, with their seq, and the hash index simply leaves them out (it skips blanks). The owner-events and arrivals indexes cover them where they apply. Nothing is dropped, nothing is lost.

Noted: the old traffic.jsonl also goes to that folder before it's retired. That's a step of the migration, so I'd put it in R19.5. Proposed R19.5, 'The migration': (1) copy traffic.jsonl to D:\countinn@google.com\SpiritOS-data-backup; (2) import it into the table in file order; (3) check the row counts match; (4) the old file stays on disk, read-once legacy, never written again; (5) the way back, if a step fails: delete the table and the node keeps writing the file; (6) nodeStore.js:329's rebuild promise is rewritten citing your decision. The same encryption question applies: that file is every opened message, in plain text. Add R19.5 as written?
